# Vendored Spectrum CSS (data only, no code run)

Downloaded from the npm registry with `npm pack --ignore-scripts` on 2026-10-29. Each file is the package's `dist/index.css` (components) or `dist/css/*-vars.css` (tokens), copied unchanged. License: Apache-2.0 (`SPECTRUM-CSS-LICENSE`, from github.com/adobe/spectrum-css). Each CSS file keeps Adobe's copyright header.

| tokens/medium-vars.css | @spectrum-css/tokens | 16.0.2 |
